FIX 1 (research escalation): in .github/workflows/research-agent.yml add an `allowed_bots` input alongside `claude_code_oauth_token:` in the claude-code-action steps. Escalations only run the deep tier, so the two DEEP-tier steps (Fable-5 preferred + Opus-4.8 fallback) are the load-bearing ones; adding it to the standard step too is harmless and consistent. Recommended value: `allowed_bots: "github-actions[bot]"` (or the stripped `"github-actions"` — the action's error prints the actor stripped, so include both forms `"github-actions[bot],github-actions"` to be safe against either matching convention). Prefer the specific bot over `"*"`: this is a PUBLIC repo, and although workflow_dispatch already requires write access (no external bot can dispatch it) the explicit list is more defensible. Scheduled/manual runs have a User actor for whom allowed_bots is ignored, so the change is safe for the currently-passing schedule path.
